title: Lab - Explore the CNI
description: Find the CNI plugin and read its configuration.
scenario: Find the CNI plugin and read its configuration. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Binaries
tasks.instructions: Which CNI plugins are available on the node?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Configuration
tasks.instructions: Which plugin is configured, and what is its network type?

tasks.title: Task 3 - Kubelet
tasks.instructions: How is the kubelet told where to look?
